content.statement: Computation by sequential measurements on a cluster state.
content.explanation: Resource: cluster state (graph state). Process: prepare cluster, measure qubits in sequence, adapt bases based on outcomes. Advantages: parallel measurement, natural for photonics.
keyTakeaways: Computation by sequential measurements on a cluster state.
Know what problem or physical phenomenon 29.2 Measurement‑Based Quantum Computing (MBQC) addresses.

formulas.description: Core relation for 29.2 Measurement‑Based Quantum Computing (MBQC).

steps.title: Expand in the measurement basis
steps.text: Write |ψ⟩ = Σ_i c_i|i⟩ in the orthonormal eigenbasis of the observable.

steps.title: Project onto outcome i
steps.text: Orthogonality isolates the amplitude associated with outcome i.

steps.title: Apply Born rule
steps.text: Squaring the modulus gives the probability of observing outcome i.

codeExamples.code:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from qiskit.quantum_info import Statevector
import json

LESSON_ID = '29-29-2-measurement-based-quantum-computing-mbqc'
circuit = QuantumCircuit(1)
circuit.h(0)
from qiskit.primitives import StatevectorSampler
circuit.measure_all()
result = StatevectorSampler(seed=7).run([circuit], shots=512).result()
print(json.dumps({'lesson': LESSON_ID, 'counts': result[0].data.meas.get_counts()}))
